items.text: Epic A surface/posture UI - built: MyCluster /shefa/cluster + PeerTopology /shefa/peers (in sidenav), DeviceTile triptych, per-EPR ResilienceView Network tab, progressive icon, ConnectionIndicator chip

Epic A gap: top-level posture view (ResilienceSnapshotView/NetworkPostureView/TopologyOverviewView wire types exist, no consuming component); free/used <dl> text not clickable bar; peer/device cards not links (no drill-down)

Epic B committed accounting - built: cluster_view observed free/used+stewarded, constitutional_ratio_registry donut clamp, bounds_validator 7 checks, RS(4,3) sharding, replication.rs state machine, shard_manifests/locations/allocations CRUD, placement_gaps/household_resilience projections

Epic B gap: peer_capacity_service 3 reader stubs return 0 (query_latest_total_raw_bytes, aggregate_pledges_by_tier, compute_unique_shard_bytes); replication_prioritizer::score_advertised_blob DEAD CODE not wired into drain_gap_queue/inventory subscriber
Epic C doorway Role-2 resolver - gap: Role 2 (Resolver) ABSENT (no EPR head/CID -> DHT provider records -> pull bytes libp2p -> cache -> serve); REQUIRES p2p-design-gate; reach enforced peer-side

Epic D account-management - built: Login/AuthService password+OAuth+Tauri, doorway auth_routes recovery handlers, RecoveryCoordinatorService + Request/Interview/ElohimVerify DNA-notarized, social Profile

Epic D gap: Account-Management surface MISSING in elohim-app (only hosted-only doorway-app stub); no post-recovery key rotation (compromised key not revoked - dangerous); graduated-authority tier not surfaced; passkey/2FA unimplemented; no password-reset CTA. Build imagodei/components/account-management/

Epic E context menus - built: <elohim-context-menu> Lit primitive + Library A/B stories (ZERO app consumers); <elohim-epr-link> integrated via EprLinkComponent + EprPopover; EprRelationshipCard + qahal ContextMenuOnly exist but neither wired to EPR links

Epic E gap (integration not greenfield): wire <elohim-context-menu> into EprLinkComponent (right-click/long-press), populate ContextMenuItem[] with EPR actions (view/navigate-to-Network/steward/replicate/relationships/governance); make reach-vs-delivery-vs-persistence boundary legible (3 glyph sets exist)

Epic F delivery stats - built: replication stats (api/resilience.rs households/peers/health, placement-gaps, /p2p/status); gap: delivery stats ABSENT (no bytes-served/who-pulled/toll-settled endpoint, no blob-served aggregation, finance-bridge absent); toll economics separate v1 decision

Epic G join elohim ceiling to floor - gap: wisdom.rs input shape accepts only constitution/framing/event_summary -> no agent can reason over placement-gaps/resilience/inventory; grow input shape + feed live projections; sense-and-respond only; sequence LAST after B

Operator-lane/infra deps: alpha conductor DNA installed + signal subscriber; DNA pipeline /cargo-target PVC disk-full #1303; elohim-doorway-app/dev Jenkins job missing; publish-but-mark-unstable for packed happ
